data.action: 赤足盘腿坐于平整礁石上，双手轻按膝头横放大剑
data.camera: full body, wide shot, 全身中全景，平礁、巨剑与平缓水面同框
data.description: 退潮时分浮出水面的平整黑礁石上，斯卡蒂赤足盘腿而坐，巨剑平稳横放在膝上，任由清凉的浅水漫过脚边。午后日光洒在平静的海面与银白长发上，她微微低眸，享受着远离喧嚣的片刻宁静。
data.lighting: 午后清朗海面反射的自然日光
data.promptProse: Resting upon a flat black tidal reef exposed by the receding tide, Skadi sits cross-legged barefoot with her massive greatsword resting across her lap. Gentle afternoon sunlight glints off calm shallow pools around her as she looks downward in quiet repose.
data.title: 斯卡蒂 · 近海平礁的赤足小憩
data.animaCaption: Sitting cross-legged barefoot on the smooth tidal reef with her greatsword across her lap, she rests in the calm afternoon sea breeze.
